headline: Lifecycle guard removed from data bucket without documented replacement

findings.evidence_ref: The PR description states a 'lifecycle guard' on the data bucket was removed to unblock CI. The code comment in data_stores.tf notes 'Retention is a compliance requirement, hence the guard,' but the guard is no longer present in the updated code.
findings.explanation: A lifecycle protection that was documented as a compliance requirement has been removed without clarifying what replacement safeguard is in place. While versioning is still enabled, if the removed guard was a prevent_destroy rule or similar, accidental deletion is now possible. The PR description suggests this was done to work around a CI failure rather than addressing the root cause. Before merging, clarify: (1) what lifecycle configuration was removed, (2) whether it was protecting against accidental deletion or modification, and (3) what compensating control now prevents the compliance violation.
